findings.claim: The new catch-all `*://*) return 0` also classifies compound-scheme ssh URLs such as git+ssh://localhost/... or ssh+git://localhost/... as network remotes. Before this change those went through the host check and were local when the host was localhost. The commit message says only ssh:// and scp forms are local, so this is probably intended, but no test covers these schemes.

evidence: Reviewed the full diff. The ssh:// branch keeps the old host extraction, and the other schemes now return 0 early.
The new tests cover http on localhost, https on 127.0.0.1, and an upper-case SSH://LOCALHOST. The input is lowercased before the case match, so that last case still matches ssh://*.
The part of the function after the shown hunk (the host comparison) is not in the diff, so I could not check it beyond what the diff shows.
